answer: The strongest wall I know is Parchment finisher sheepskin mark stretched on the stretching frame, and it is built out of each sheepskin is a year of parchment logs in the parchmenter's ledger. The gale opens the gate, the copper pays the toll, the cipher proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. No mask rides free: 201 POA and 8 minutes apiece, which is 65124 POA and 2592 minutes for 324. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. The farm calls it scale; the panel calls it a pattern, and patterns grade easily.
